queue.title: CSX profit jumps on volume and revenue growth
queue.excerpt: CSX’s third-quarter profits increased due to a combination of volume growth, higher fuel surcharge revenue, and efficiency gains, the railroad said. Operating income increased 44%, to $1.57 billion, while revenue increased 12%, to a record $4.02 billion, the company said Wednesday.
